leakage_signals: The phrase 'not doing recruiting this time' suggests possible prior-user or prior-trip context, but it supplies no usable preference rule for ranking these itineraries.
verdict.rationale: No itinerary clearly dominates. B arrives relatively early with one connection but has a tight 53-minute ATL connection. C is the cheapest and earliest-arriving option but adds a second connection and associated disruption risk. D is nearly as cheap as C and has a very safe single connection, but arrives substantially later. A costs more, but its single 89-minute connection is more robust than B's while arriving earlier than D. Choosing among cost, arrival time, connection count, and connection reliability requires an unstated preference.
